# mockingbird_workspace (Resource)

A workspace: an isolated set of mocks, LLM profiles, scenarios and API keys. Creating one needs a sysadmin credential (or `auth.mode: none`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mockingbird_workspace" "staging" {
  name         = "staging"
  display_name = "Staging"
  # Also delete the workspace's mocks and LLM profiles on destroy.
  force_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name, `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$`. Changing it replaces the workspace.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name. Defaults to `name`.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the workspace's mocks and LLM profiles with it on destroy. Without it, destroying a non-empty workspace fails.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Identifier, `<name>`; also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A workspace is imported by its name.
terraform import mockingbird_workspace.staging staging
```
